name: Viraj Aero
long_description:
Viraj Aero builds gas turbines that deliver both power and cooling water for data centers. It needs no grid connection and no water pipeline.

Burning natural gas already produces water. Our patented system captures that water from the exhaust. Part of it cools the data center. The rest is turned into steam and injected back into the turbine. That gives up to 40% more power from the same fuel (cheaper compute) and cuts NOx emissions by up to 99%, which cuts permit approvals from years to weeks.

We're building a genset around our first-of-its-kind gas turbine. It fits in a 10-foot container and runs anywhere, even in the desert. That matters because two-thirds of new data centers are being built in water-stressed regions.

We first built this steam-injected turbine for aircraft, where carrying water tanks isn't an option and efficiency is critical. We're currently integrating our full-scale prototype into an aircraft. The team comes from GE, Rolls-Royce and Formula 1, and we're already working with Safran, one of the world's largest aircraft engine manufacturers.

launches.title: Viraj Aero: The gas turbine that powers and cools data centers
launches.tagline: Aeroderivative turbine gensets that make power and water on-site, so data centers don't wait on the grid.
launches.body:
Hey everyone ! We're [Mathilde](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mathilde-bouilloux/) and [Joseph](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joseph-risson/), co-founders of [Viraj Aero](https://www.viraj-aero.com/).

**TL;DR**

Viraj Aero (YC F26) builds a gas turbine that gives data centers both their power and their cooling water, with no water connection and no wait for the grid. We already have over 1.3 GW of demand under letters of intent, and one of the world's largest engine manufacturers is a paying customer. 

Burning natural gas produces water, and Viraj captures it. Our proprietary system recovers water directly from the turbine exhaust. Part of it cools the data center. The rest goes back into the turbine as steam, delivering 40% more power with the same amount of fuel, with emissions low enough to get permits approved in weeks instead of months.

We first built this turbine for aviation and after a series of ground tests, it is now being integrated into an aircraft. Designed to fly, it can run anywhere : on the ground, it becomes a compact, standalone unit that installs even in the desert.

▶️ <https://youtu.be/XZghETY1lV4>

**The Problem**

AI data centers need two things: power and water. Today they can't get either fast enough.

* The grid can't keep up. New data centers are told to wait years for a connection.
* Water is running out. Two-thirds of new data centers are going up in water-stressed regions. Communities push back, permits stall, projects die.

 

**Our Solution**

We build a compact, standalone gas turbine genset with one twist: it makes its own water.

Burning gas produces water. Our patented water recovery system captures it from the turbine exhaust, and that water does two jobs:

1. It cools the data center. No water connection needed.
2. It goes back into the turbine as steam. That gives up to 40% more power from the same fuel and up to 99% lower NOx emissions, so permits take weeks instead of years.

Our first product is a 10 MW genset built from stacked turbine modules: redundant by design, and expandable as your data center grows. 

**Why Us**

We're aerospace engineers from GE, Rolls-Royce, Safran and Formula 1. Operations are led by the former Managing Director of GE Aerospace France, and our CTO has built a complete engine from scratch. Joseph is a Supaero turbomachinery engineer (Ascendance, Beyond Aero YC W22). Mathilde has developed 120+ MW of power projects (Neoen, VINCI, Banque des Territoires).

**Born to Fly**

As aerospace engineers, we first built this turbine for aviation and after a series of ground tests, it is now being integrated into an aircraft. Designed to fly, it can run anywhere : on the ground, it becomes a compact, standalone unit that installs even in the desert. 

**Our Ask**

If any of these are you, we'd love to talk:

* Data center developers and hyperscalers who need firm on-site power for 2028+
* Neoclouds and energy teams building in water-stressed regions
* Gas turbine packagers and operators who want more power and lower NOx from their existing fleet

👉 [mathilde.bouilloux@viraj-aero.com](mailto:mathilde@viraj-aero.com) and [joseph.risson@viraj-aero.com](mailto:joseph@viraj-aero.com)
